notes: Blocked. A free copy of the article exists only on scraping sites (typeset.io), which the brief rules out. Two routes for the human: (1) the article through a library login (Springer); (2) the authors' open-access 2001 review on the same subject (Søndergaard, M., Jensen, J. P. & Jeppesen, E. 2001. Retention and internal loading of phosphorus in shallow, eutrophic lakes. The Scientific World Journal 1: 427–442, doi:10.1100/tsw.2001.72, CC BY; PMC6084181) — its PDF opens in an ordinary browser. Its abstract (seen, not evidence) says summer concentrations rise and retention may be negative most of the summer, which is the phenomenon chem3.js models; whether either paper gives a Q₁₀ for oxic release (the 2.5 in §4.3) is the thing to check, as is the '2–4×' summer increase that REL_OXIC 0.0015 was tuned to.
